title: The Azure Unbowed Canon
summary: A canon of a will that stands clear and upright under the open sky and draws the force of a blow into itself to answer it.

title: Treatise of the Skysworn Will
summary: A treatise of the cultivation-side order on a sworn will that holds a whole rank firm and returns a break in the rank as a counterstroke.

title: The Sapphire Fortitude Mastery
summary: A mastery of a cold clear fortitude that cannot be heated into rage or chilled into fear and that lends its stillness to others.

title: Canon of the Clear Zenith Mind
summary: A canon of a mind raised to a bright still height where no dread or doubt can follow and no deception stays hidden.

title: The Windward Resolve Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of resolve that leans into the wind of battle and turns that wind into the user's own speed and force.

title: The Oath-Tempered Heart Canon
summary: A canon of a heart tempered by a spoken oath until the oath itself becomes the armour and the blade.

title: Treatise of the Storm-Held Will
summary: A treatise on a will held steady in the middle of a storm of blows and then loosed in one thunderous return.

title: The Gale Fortitude Mastery
summary: A full mastery of fortitude in the Gale manner that outlasts any blow and carries the weary through a long campaign.

title: Manual of the Sworn Unfaltering
summary: A manual for the sworn who do not falter and who lend that firmness to comrades and call the fallen back to it.

title: The Tempest Heart Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of a heart that grows wilder as the tempest rises and strikes its hardest at the peak of the storm.
